paragraphs.text: The Chaos Orb was a powerful artifact used by the planeswalker Ravidel that blasted all of the ports in Arathoxia during his invasion of the city, killing Marshal Bikov .
As one of the manual dexterity cards , Chaos Orb is banned in sanctioned constructed formats including Vintage .

According to a possibly apocryphal story, a player almost won a tournament by tearing a Chaos Orb into pieces in order to destroy all of their opponent's permanents, the judge declared this illegal because the deck was now missing cards. This inspired the Unglued card Chaos Confetti , which references the story in its flavor text.
Mark Tedin 's art for Chaos Orb ( Alpha ) was based on Zardoz, a giant floating head from the 1974 movie of the same name .
